messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:

- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- On 2026-01-01, Team Cinder noticed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-01-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-01-01]
- On 2025-12-17, Team Dune's standup decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident affecting the indexer on 2025-10-13. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Incremental updates to the indexer left stale entries behind after failed writes. [valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- On 2026-02-12, the Ember team observed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2026-02-12 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-02-12]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- On 2025-11-06, Team Dune reported that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2025-11-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-06]
- The INC-2025-023 review on 2025-10-16 decided that reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- Team Boreal kept the notifier until 2025-04-04. [valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
- As of 2026-02-24, the feature-flags service lives with Team Cinder; Team Boreal kept it until then. [valid 2026-02-24 to now; recorded by handover/2026-02-24-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Boreal as of 2025-09-29. [valid 2025-09-29 to 2026-02-24; recorded by handover/2025-09-29-feature-flags]
    earlier: The feature-flags service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-09-29; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-16 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- As of 2025-06-19, the notifier lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-06-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-19-notifier]
    earlier: As of 2025-04-04, the notifier lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-04-04 to 2025-06-19; recorded by handover/2025-04-04-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier lives with Team Boreal. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-04-04; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]
- Dashboards and alerts for the catalog service are being repointed as of 2025-06-16. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
- On 2025-05-08, Team Boreal observed that the catalog service's memory use grew steadily for a week following the cache change, and flagged it since the catalog service is not Team Boreal's service. [valid 2025-05-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-05-08]
- As of 2026-03-16, the catalog service deploys on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2026-03-16]
    earlier: The catalog service ships only on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-24 to 2026-03-16; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
